subject: PO issuance request — Acme Logistics onboarding: provisional PO, spend cap, SKU splits
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-logistics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Logistics Proc Team <procurement@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO and SKU split questions

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are ready to move forward with Redwood for our freight-optimization agent. Procurement needs a provisional PO and clear spend-cap guidance to finalize internal approvals. A few specifics from finance:

- We expect an initial commitment of $120,000 for Q2 and want that set as a provisional spend cap on the PO.
- The invoicing team requires line-level SKU mapping so each internal cost center can be charged correctly. At the moment our catalogue lists two SKUs that should be split across two cost centers (SKU-FREIGHT-STD -> 60/40 split).
- Please confirm whether Redwood can issue a provisional PO number now (we can accept an internal provisional tag) while you complete ledger mapping.

I've attached our completed onboarding form and an export of the line items for your team to reference. Can you confirm next steps and an ETA for the provisional PO?

Best,
Jordan
Jordan Myers
Senior Buyer — Acme Logistics
procurement@acme-logistics.com
Attachment: acme_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 312 KB); acme_lineitems_20260405.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO and SKU split questions

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the form. Looping in Monica (procurement ops) and Marcus (finance ops) to handle PO issuance and ledger mapping. Quick responses to your bullets below: 

- Provisional PO: we can issue a provisional PO number immediately so your approvals can proceed. We generally tag provisional POs as "PON-YYYY-XXXX-provisional" until final ledger assignment is complete.
- Spend cap: we will set the provisional PO ceiling to $120,000 as requested. If you expect large one-off usage above that in the first month, flag and we can add a controlled burst cap.
- SKU split: Marcus — can you confirm how you'd like the 60/40 split represented on the final line items (separate line entries vs single line with allocation notes)?

Jordan — we'll aim to issue a provisional PO within 48 business hours pending Marcus's ledger instructions. Monica will track the ticket and send the official PO file.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO and SKU split questions

Hannah / Monica / Jordan —

Recommend representing the 60/40 split as two separate ledger lines on the PO so Acme's internal cost centers can reconcile automatically. Example:

- SKU-FREIGHT-STD | Qty 1 | Unit $X | Account 420-Logistics | 60% allocation (Cost center A)
- SKU-FREIGHT-STD | Qty 1 | Unit $X | Account 421-Logistics | 40% allocation (Cost center B)

We'll include allocation tags (acct codes) and a short free-text note on each line item indicating the split percentage. Monica — once you generate the provisional PO, please include these two lines and the spend-cap = $120,000 in the PO header. Jordan — confirm those acct codes match your ERP expectations; if not, send the preferred account codes and we'll swap them.

I'll draft the PO header text and attach a provisional PO stub for review.

Marcus
Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: provisional_po_stub.docx (DOCX, 28 KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding — provisional PO and SKU split questions

Jordan — attaching the finalized provisional PO and confirmation PDF. Details below: 

PO number: PON-2026-0783 (provisional)
Spend cap: $120,000 (PO header)
Line items: SKU-FREIGHT-STD split into two lines with account tags 420-Logistics (60%) and 421-Logistics (40%) as requested
Ledger note: "Provisional routing — final ledger assignment pending internal vendor code activation; do not book until final notice."

Attachments: PON-2026-0783-confirmation.pdf (official provisional PO), provisional_po_stub.docx (internal), mapping_notes.txt (internal)

Jordan — please confirm receipt and that the account codes map into your ERP correctly. Once you reply "ACK" we'll mark the onboarding ticket as ready for legal and billing to complete final onboarding.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
